verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents first-party experimentation with Bayesian results that surface a leading or winning variation (docs-30, 34, 57). It also offers programmatic surfaces an agent can use: scoped read-only API tokens (docs-67) and an official MCP server for flags, configs and observability data (docs-59, probe-4). None of these sources explicitly says experiment configurations or results can be read through the API or MCP, so agent-driven experiment summarization is only implied. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for experiment configs and results, documented agent workflows for ship/rollback recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
